alerts.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 24 at 9:49PM PST until November 26 at 12:00PM PST by NWS Seattle WA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph expected.

* WHERE...Portions of northwest and west central Washington.

* WHEN...From 8 PM Wednesday to noon PST Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Watch issued November 24 at 6:10PM PST until November 26 at 5:00PM PST by NWS Seattle WA
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding
expected. Inundation of 2 to 3 feet above ground level is
possible Wednesday along shorelines and low-lying coastal areas.
For the Coastal Flood Watch, significant coastal flooding
possible Thursday with inundation up to 2.5 to 3.5 feet.

* WHERE...Lowlands of Western Whatcom County, Lowlands of
Western Skagit and Northwestern Snohomish Counties, Downtown
Everett / Marysville Area, Shoreline / Lynnwood / South
Everett Area, City of Seattle, Lowlands of Pierce and Southern
King Counties, Northern Hood Canal, Eastern Kitsap County and
Island County zones.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, from 2 AM to 9 AM PST
Wednesday. For the Coastal Flood Watch, from late Wednesday
night through Thursday afternoon.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
may be inundated. Some shoreline erosion may occur.

sonora_ca.name: Sonora
sonora_ca.obs_note: Sonora has no NWS observing station. The readings come from the Green Spring fire-weather station, 12 miles away and about 700 ft lower.
